component.name: TuxDisplay
component.summary: Extend a GNOME Wayland desktop to an iPad over USB

description.p: TuxDisplay creates a native GNOME Wayland extended monitor and streams it directly to the OpenDisplay iPad app over USB without requiring an IP network or Personal Hotspot.
An authenticated browser receiver remains available for private networks and compatibility use.
Desktop sessions without the required GNOME virtual-monitor APIs use an isolated X11 workspace rather than extending the current desktop.
The standalone manager and tray indicator show whether the display is stopped, waiting, or actively connected.

ul.li: Accept GNOME's negotiated PipeWire rate to restore pipeline startup.
Limit capture without buffering the first damage-driven frame.
Validate video startup before opening the USB transport.
Keep capture, encoding, and receiver cadence consistent.
Recover stalled OpenDisplay sessions with a fresh keyframe or reconnect.
Bound shutdown and restore browser sessions after display restarts.
